title: Iramba language - Wikipedia
text: Iramba, also known as Nilamba (there is no distinction between [ɾ] and [l]) is a Bantu language spoken by the Nilamba and Iambi people of the Iramba District in the Singida Region of Tanzania. The 50,000 Iambi speak a slightly divergent dialect, sometimes listed as a distinct language.

title: Nilamba
